name: hackshop
description: Hosted MCP for planning Muse gadget bodies: intake questions, board picks with difficulty, build plans with flash warnings, shopping lists and machine-readable assembly steps.
transport_notes: Stateless, POST only. No mcp-session-id is issued; GET and DELETE return 405. CORS allows any origin.

tools.name: intake_gadget
tools.description: The 4 intake questions, why they matter and how answers map to plan_gadget.

tools.name: plan_gadget
tools.description: Plan a Muse gadget body from the intake answers: fit, warnings, notes, picks with difficulty and build links.

tools.name: get_build_plan
tools.description: Return difficulty, flash warnings, parts, shopping list, assembly steps with checks, commands and agent brief for a device.

tools.name: assess_hackability
tools.description: Look up catalog hackability, brick risk, firmware links and build support.
